parameters.name: mask_source
parameters.label: Canopy Mask Source
parameters.description: 'auto' isolates canopy from the image with ExG thresholding; 'file' reads the mask_path produced by the Module 4 plugin.

parameters.name: mask_path
parameters.label: Canopy Mask File
parameters.description: Absolute path to a vegetation mask PNG (white = canopy). Required when mask_source is 'file'; must match the image dimensions.

parameters.name: exg_threshold
parameters.label: ExG Canopy Threshold
parameters.description: Excess-green threshold for the automatic canopy mask.

parameters.name: min_brightness
parameters.label: Minimum Brightness
parameters.description: Luminance below this is treated as shadow, not canopy (auto mask only).

parameters.name: max_brightness
parameters.label: Maximum Brightness
parameters.description: Luminance above this is treated as glare or cloud, not canopy (auto mask only).

parameters.name: threshold_vigorous
parameters.label: Vigorous VARI Threshold
parameters.description: Canopy pixels with VARI at or above this are classed vigorous.

parameters.name: threshold_moderate
parameters.label: Moderate VARI Threshold
parameters.description: Canopy pixels at or above this (but below vigorous) are moderate stress; lower values are severe stress.

parameters.name: yellowing_hue_min
parameters.label: Yellowing Hue Min
parameters.description: Lower bound of the HSL hue window that marks chlorosis.

parameters.name: yellowing_hue_max
parameters.label: Yellowing Hue Max
parameters.description: Upper bound of the chlorosis hue window.

parameters.name: yellowing_sat_min
parameters.label: Yellowing Saturation Min
parameters.description: Minimum saturation for a yellow pixel to count as chlorotic.

parameters.name: browning_min_rbvi
parameters.label: Browning RBVI Threshold
parameters.description: Minimum Red-Blue Vegetation Index for necrotic foliage.

parameters.name: browning_r_g_ratio
parameters.label: Browning R/G Ratio
parameters.description: Red channel must exceed this multiple of green for browning.

parameters.name: grid_size
parameters.label: Condition Grid Size
parameters.description: Zonation divides the image into grid_size × grid_size cells and reports condition per cell.

parameters.name: plots
parameters.label: Plots (JSON)
parameters.description: Optional JSON array for per-plot condition, e.g. [{"plot_id":"A","polygon":[[lon,lat],...]}].
